text: いまは　パソコンつうしんで　どうぐや　ポケモンを　データにして　おくれるんだと

structure.jp: どうぐや　ポケモンを　データにして
structure.en: turning items and Pokémon into data
you can send them, they say

patterns.name: 〜と (quoting)
patterns.explanation: と at the very end shows the speaker is passing on what someone else said, with 'they say' left unspoken. おくれるんだと = 'I hear you can send them'.

patterns.name: 〜で (how)
patterns.explanation: で after a thing shows it is the tool or way used to do something. パソコンつうしんで = 'by PC communications'.

patterns.name: 〜にする
patterns.explanation: A thing plus にする means to turn something into that thing. データにして = 'turning them into data, and then'.
